conventions.stat: mean and sample s.d. (ddof=1) over seeds; per_seed lists the run ids
conventions.test_set: ISIC 2018 test (n=966) unless stated; PH2: all 200 images

cAUROC.description: test concept AUROC (mean over the 5 structures)

Dice.description: test structure-mask Dice (images with the structure present)

OIS.description: oracle impurity score (lower = less leakage between concept representations)

flip.description: artefact flip rate (fraction of predictions changed by artefacts)

PH2_AUROC.description: PH2 (200 images) AUROC melanoma vs nevus from P(melanoma)

deferral_AUC.description: area under the accuracy-coverage curve, max-prob deferral

ECE_ts.description: test ECE after temperature scaling (T fit on val NLL)

locTV_free.description: diagnosis TV under blur outside the lesion, masks recomputed (expert lesion for mask-free models)

locTV_fixed.description: diagnosis TV under blur outside the predicted lesion, masks frozen (mask models only)

loc_concept_delta_free.description: mean |dp| of concept probabilities under blur outside all expert structures

loc_concept_delta_fixed.description: mean |dp| of concept probabilities under blur outside predicted structures, masks frozen

CLS.description: counterfactual locality score, mean over LaMa structure removals

XE.description: cross-effect of a structure removal on the other concepts, mean

havasi_soft_minus_hard.description: BACC with soft minus hard concepts through the head

conventions.official_baselines: CBM-joint and CEM rows = official-recipe runs bl_cbm_joint_s*, bl_cem_s*; in-house configs under *_inhouse (internal only)

flagship.name: EB-CBM (ours)
flagship.example_run_selection: best validation BACC among the flagship seeds

ladder.protocol: logistic-regression refit on cumulative head-input groups (train -> test BACC, C on val); head_zeroed = trained head with the other inputs set to 0

sanity.protocol: logistic regression (class-balanced, standardised inputs, C in {0.01,0.1,1,10} chosen on val BACC) fit on the train split (eval transform), test BACC; random/shuffled averaged over seeds

gt_interventions.definition: delta_bacc_all_k = BACC with all 5 concepts set to the expert labels minus BACC without intervention (k=0); curves over k corrected structures

spatial_interventions.definition: expert structure masks replace predicted ones (5 structure planes; all_planes_expert also replaces the lesion plane); delta = BACC after all corrections minus BACC without intervention

oracle_ceilings.definition: linear head (logistic regression, same protocol as sanity) on expert concept labels (oracle_concepts) or labels + sqrt(area/lesion) + lesion area (oracle_concepts_areas); independent of the model up to the shared protocol

pillow_numpy_note: B_ebcrop_v3_s2, B_ebcrop_v3_discover_s1/_s2 were re-run after Pillow 9.5->12.3 / numpy 1.26->2.5 (2026-10-11 20:21 UTC); other seeds used the old versions
